biteOfDay: Fall transition is in full swing on both lakes. On Table Rock bass are feeding aggressively on points, gravel flats, and offshore structure in 20–40 ft as they pack on weight ahead of winter. Walleye and crappie continue to produce around brush and points. On Taneycomo rainbows remain eager in the seams during low flows while brown trout activity builds with the cooling water. Recent local reports

tableRock.clarity: Gin-clear near dam; verify arms locally

taneycomo.temp: Tailwater cold (typically ~50–54°F). Verify at the bank.
